capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: no page gives usable kWh for the Blazer EV. The 85 kWh 10-module Ultium pack is the same one in the Equinox EV (The Weekly Driver lists both), and the Equinox record (OpenEV) has 80 kWh usable.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: same 85 kWh 10-module Ultium pack as the Equinox EV (nominal 336 V per The Weekly Driver, 288 V per EVChargingStations; either way a 400 V-class pack, as stored for the Equinox).

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: the page is a 2026 RS AWD window sticker (11.5 kW onboard charging module). Other sources say every Blazer EV configuration has the 11.5 kW module; no 19.2 kW option found.

dc_max_kw.notes: Quick web lookup (rough, not cross-checked). Canadian listing; not confirmed by Chevrolet.

US dealer page: LT and RS (85 kWh) up to 150 kW; 190 kW is the 102 kWh SS. Same wording on a 2026 RS AWD window sticker (src-coughlin-2026-blazer-ev-rs-awd) and in EVChargingStations (2027 article). Conflicts with the 190 kW already stored from thinkEV (which says 102 kWh for all trims; likely wrong for the 85 kWh pack).
